title: Electrician Royal Beach Club
description:
Position Summary:

The Electrician specializes in the maintenance and safe operation of all electrical equipment on the Private Destination, this includes high voltage equipment. This role diagnoses issues, fixes equipment, and maintains records of inspections. This position demonstrates exemplary skills in overhauling and maintaining all electrical equipment. The Electrician follows all safety protocols to ensure the safety of Guests, visitors, and fellow Team Members. This role is committed to a safety-first culture to ensure optimum safety for Guests, Visitors, and Team Members.

All duties and responsibilities are performed following Companyâs Brand Standards, the Royal Way philosophy, policies, and SOPs, public health, safety, security, and environmental guidelines.

This Job Description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by the Team Member occupying this position. All Team Members may be required to perform any other job-related duties assigned by their Supervisor or Management. The nature of this job requires daily interactions with internal and external stakeholders.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ensures safe operation of all electrical equipment in the kitchen venues and laundry rooms.
  • Performs maintenance on electrical vehicles, e-trams, and e-bikes, heavy machinery, and boats.
  • Understands the CCTV/Data System and fixes the issues.
  • Performs Fire Alarm System inspections and maintenance.
  • Inspects and ensures the Audio & Video System (Videlio) are in working condition.
  • Sets up and maintains the satellite dish system and TV units in the accommodation, offices, and venues.
  • Ensures the weather stations antenna is in working condition for daily operation.
  • Assists Supervisor to work on high voltage equipment.
  • Follows safety protocols while working with electrical equipment, ensuring the own safety and safety of others.
  • Demonstrate a safety-first culture and follows the Companyâs policies and procedures.
  • Determines the suitability and appropriateness of all electrical equipment newly acquired or in operation.
  • Understands how to use electrical system documentation such as drawings, service, and instruction manuals.
  • Determines if all components and parts used in the electrical systems are covered by the AMOS maintenance jobs and advises the Electronic Manager of any discrepancies.
  • Responds to, diagnoses, and fixes electrical issues. Applies safety regulations and safety practices at all times.
  • Reads work orders, maintains records of daily tasks, and discusses challenges with the Electronic Manager.
  • Ensure that all electrical spare parts are available in ample quantity to perform the job safely.
  • Uses clear, concise, and professional communication in person, over the radio, and in written format.
  • Demonstrates effective teamwork and collaboration, and time management skills.
  • Maintains an orderly and clean work area, with all tools in good repair.
  • Adheres to all Company policies regarding PPE and Chemical Management.
  • Sets up and closes working areas as per schedule or as instructed by the Management Team.
  • Participates in trainings and meetings. Adheres to a Company confidentiality agreement.
  • Follows the destinationâs grooming standards. Ensures personal appearance, hygiene, and uniform appearance are always in accordance with Company policy. Maintains a safe and sanitary environment for Guests and the Team.
  • Acknowledges and greets Guests, visitors, and Team Members in public spaces with a warm, friendly greeting.


Financial Responsibilities

  • Maintains the inventory of tools and equipment.
  • Determines inventory and compiles a bi-weekly list of all supplies/tools needed.


Qualifications:

  • A High School Diploma or basic education equivalency.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of progressive technical experience and training in a resort or marine environment.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of operational experience with electrical equipment, including power generation, sewage treatment plants, incinerators, potable water production, satellite communications, and operating equipment.
  • Advanced knowledge of electrical systems, needs assessment, problem resolution, and quality standards.
  • Valid license or certificate(s) in the area of technical specialty are required.
  • Good interpersonal skills to communicate with all levels of Management and Team Members.
  • Ability to work positively and cooperatively in a diverse international environment.
  • Ability to maintain focus, work with strict deadlines, multitask and be flexible and adaptable.


Language Requirements:

  • Ability to speak English clearly, distinctly, and cordially with Guests, Team Members, Contractors, and Vendors.
  • Ability to read and write English, to understand and interpret written procedures. This includes the ability to give and receive instructions in written and verbal forms and to effectively present information and respond to questions from Guests, Managers, and Team Members.


Physical Requirements:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to touch, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and taste and smell. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • All destination Team Members must be physically able to participate in emergency life-saving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal, and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency.


Work Environment:

  • Destination outdoor environment where high temperature, precipitation, and humid temperatures are experienced.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is required to work outdoors in extremely humid and hot conditions for an extended period of time.

This is a position where duties are exercised outdoors, walking in sand, and uneven surfaces, and high scaffolding.

title: Detail Specialist
description:
U-Haul Detail Technician

Are you ready to rev up your career? U-Haul is looking for new team members to clean and detail the newest trucks and trailer fleet in the industry, ensuring that our equipment remains in top condition for our customers. If you have the skills and passion to keep our fleet looking the best, then this is the start of a career opportunity at U-Haul for you!

Working in our detail bays is a great way to begin your career at U-Haul and allows you to learn on the job and move up to other positions within the Company. We have the largest fleet of trucks and trailers in the industry and we need a first-class team to keep them looking great for our customers.

title: Recognizing the Friction
description:
Virtual works adequately for many meetings. But how big is the gap between adequate and optimal for any given meeting? The mode decision should weigh the meeting's importance against the friction of meeting in person â not default to either one.

tClara

  • survey of 522 US-based business leaders, including 95 C-suite respondents
  • Across 26 meeting goals, 43% of leaders rate in-person as the better mode, 35% say virtual, and 22% say mode barely matters â the decision is genuinely goal-dependent, not a fixed rule.
  • In-person is the preferred mode for 22 of 26 goals â especially building trust and teamwork, persuading or selling, and solving important problems.
  • Virtual is preferred for goals like gathering diverse opinions, sharing updates, and using people's time efficiently.
  • Virtual meetings are seen as nearly twice as likely to produce a negative outcome as in-person meetings (47% vs. 25%) â convenience carries real risk.
  • 70% of leaders say a deliberate blend of virtual and in-person work allows them to do their best work; C-suite respondents value in-person meetings more than other leaders do (53% vs. 41%).

title: Director Proposal Management Defense and Space
description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Proposal Management to lead Defense and Space proposal operations supporting U.S. Government, OEM Defense, International Defense, and Space customers. This senior leadership role is responsible for driving winning proposal strategies, leading high-performing teams, improving proposal processes, and ensuring successful execution of complex RFQ, RFI, and RFP opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a transformational leader with deep expertise in proposal management, government contracting, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement. This individual will work closely with executive leadership, sales, engineering, finance, and operations teams to secure new business and retain existing customers.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a diverse team of proposal management professionals.
  • Conduct performance evaluations, coaching, and career development planning.
  • Establish performance metrics and productivity goals.
  • Develop succession plans and build organizational capability for future growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Process Improvement & Operations Excellence

  • Identify and implement process improvement initiatives to increase proposal quality, efficiency, and responsiveness.
  • Leverage automation and emerging technologies, including generative AI, to improve proposal operations.
  • Monitor key operational metrics and present results to executive leadership.
  • Improve proposal turnaround times and on-time delivery performance.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Engineering, Finance, Contracts, and Program Management teams to develop compelling solutions.
  • Facilitate executive reviews, proposal kickoffs, and compliance reviews.
  • Analyze risks, opportunities, and business impacts to support strategic decision-making.
  • Present proposal performance, business insights, and organizational recommendations to senior executives.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of proposal management experience in Aerospace, Defense, Government Contracting, or related industries.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience managing professional teams.
  • Strong understanding of RFQ, RFI, and RFP processes.
  • Knowledge of FAR and government proposal compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Proven success managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelorâs Degree, Management, Operations, or related field
  • APMP membership or certification.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com and data analytics tools.
  • Experience implementing process automation and AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Background supporting Defense, Aerospace, Aviation, or Space customers.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Proposal Management
  • Project Management
  • Business Process Improvement
  • Executive Communication
  • Relationship Building
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Planning & Scheduling
  • Risk Management
  • Team Development
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Customer Focus

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased proposal win rates and business growth.
  • Improved proposal productivity, quality, and turnaround times.
  • Strong employee engagement and talent development.
  • Consistent on-time proposal delivery
  • Effective implementation of process improvements and operational efficiencies

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
  • Employee assistance program and educational assistance
  • Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
  • Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space â from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.

Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
SoSafe is shifting from a broad-market approach to a deliberate, segment-led GTM model. This role is central to that transition. As Manager of Segment & Solutions Marketing, you will own the positioning, messaging, and solution architecture for SoSafe's priority segments. These can be defined by geography, industry vertical, customer lifecycle stage, or Human Risk maturity.

We have a foundation to build from: a defined maturity model that maps how organisations progress in their Human Risk journey, a growing understanding of how customer needs differ across lifecycle stages and a set of priority markets and geographies. What we don't yet have is the messaging, the plays, and the product experience layer that makes those segments feel served

Your role is to and translate that work into measurable improvements in win rates, market penetration, and net revenue retention. This is a newly created role in Product Marketing that you’ll have influence to shape and will work in close partnership with GTM, Product, Sales, CS, and the Commercial Centre of Excellence.

Location: This role can be fully remote from anywhere in Germany, or hybrid from one of our offices in Cologne, Munich or Berlin.

Segmented Messaging

  • Own messaging for defined priority segments — including lifecycle stage (new business, upsell, cross-sell, retention), maturity tier, geography, and industry vertical (e.g. financial services, manufacturing)

  • Develop segment-specific value propositions written in buyer language: the situation they face, the consequence of inaction, how SoSafe solves it, and why SoSafe over alternatives without jargon, no feature lists

  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, messaging iteration, persona development, and competitive synthesis as a standard part of your workflow

  • Maintain and evolve messaging as product capabilities, customer insights, and the competitive landscape shift — keeping SoSafe's market fit current and differentiated

  • Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to proactively inform segment strategy and portfolio planning

Solution Development

  • Define solution sets for priority segments: which SoSafe capabilities address their most pressing needs, framed around business outcomes rather than product features

  • Process voice-of-customer research, win/loss data, competitive intelligence, and regulatory context into compelling segment narratives and solution architectures

  • Partner with the Commercial CoE to inform pricing, packaging, bundling, and programme decisions — contributing market and segment evidence to commercial recommendations that drive share within defined segments

GTM Readiness

  • Develop SPICED-aligned talk tracks for each priority segment, grounding rep conversations in the buyer's situation before working back to solution language

  • Build and maintain a library of scalable, reusable field assets e.g. solution briefs, demo scripts, battle cards, objection-handling guides, buyer and implementation guides — leveraging AI to produce, iterate, and personalise at speed

  • Validate messaging and demo content before market release through structured rep feedback sessions, customer interviews, and early cohort exposure

  • Input into coordinated multi-touch plays across Marketing, Sales, and CS that drive upsell and cross-sell into the install base — with clear pipeline and NRR impact metrics tied to each play

  • Track asset utilisation, field feedback, and segment performance data (win rates, pipeline velocity, NRR contribution) to continuously improve GTM effectiveness and demonstrate commercial impact


What you will bring

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS in product marketing, solutions marketing or segment marketing with a proven track record of producing segment-specific or lifecycle-specific positioning

  • Demonstrated ability to write in buyer language: situation, problem, solution, outcome - not functional feature lists

  • Proficiency with competitive intelligence tools and a bias towards activating insight into sales & field-facing content, enriching the quality of their conversations

  • Proven AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to compress research cycles, pressure-test messaging, generate content variations, and move from insight to asset faster than a traditional workflow allows

  • Strong cross-functional operating skills, able to align Product, Sales, CS, and Commercial stakeholders around a segment strategy and drive execution

Preferred

  • Experience in cybersecurity, HR tech or a similarly technical B2B environment

  • Experience defining or contributing to solution sets and commercial packaging, not just messaging deliverables.

  • Background in structured pre-launch validation: rep councils, messaging test sessions, early cohort feedback

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

About Escape


Escape secures the code-to-cloud attack surface that covers DAST, ASM and AI Pentesting. Our platform continuously maps and tests every asset exposed to the internet, including undocumented APIs and endpoints, with automated AI penetration testing and DAST running at the pace of modern development teams.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18 million deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, our vision is a world where no lives are lost or damaged from the effects of high blood pressure. Our mission is to make this a reality by developing tech to help people control their blood pressure. 

We are a venture-backed scale-up, having raised over $96M from investors in Europe and the United States. Our technology — rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM) — is the world's only medically accurate, continuous blood pressure monitor that is cuffless in daily life in the consumer space. Validated through extensive clinical trials and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, our solution is now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US — a major step in bringing Hilo's technology to the millions of Americans living with high blood pressure. 

We are a hybrid/remote-first company, headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 


Role Overview 

We're looking for a Data Scientist who can turn large, complex real-world and clinical datasets into robust statistical analyses, models, and actionable insights. You will work on clinical, scientific, product, and business questions and translate data into findings that support scientific publications and informed decision-making across the company. 

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy, where you will independently take analytical questions from data preparation through statistical analysis and interpretation, while collaborating closely with clinical, scientific, product, and engineering teams. 

Requirements

What You Will Own 

  • Mine and analyse large-scale real-world data from Aktiia's databases to identify patterns, trends, and relationships related to clinical outcomes, product performance, accuracy, and usage 
  • Design, perform, and interpret statistical analyses of clinical study data, working with the clinical team on study endpoints, protocols, and appropriate analytical approaches
  • Produce analytical results into clear scientific insights, publication-ready figures, and statistical summaries that support conference presentations, posters, and peer-reviewed publications
  • Apply statistical and analytical methods to user and product data to answer questions around engagement, retention, conversion, feature usage, and segmentation 
  • Design, run, and interpret experiments and statistical tests to evaluate product or feature changes and quantify their impact 
  • Develop reproducible and traceable analytical workflows, with well-documented code, analyses, and results in line with quality and regulatory standards (ISO 13485, MDR, GCP). Contribute to our shared Python/SQL/Spark codebase through Git, CI/CD, and code review practices 
  • Select and apply appropriate statistical and modelling techniques to answer clinical, scientific, product, and business questions, assessing assumptions, limitations, and the reliability of results 

What Success Looks Like 

  • You can independently take analytical questions from data preparation through analysis and interpretation, producing reliable and reproducible results 
  • Your analyses generate clear insights that contribute to scientific publications and help Product and Leadership make informed decisions 
  • You collaborate effectively across clinical, scientific, product, and engineering teams and communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 

What we’re looking for

  • MSc (or equivalent demonstrated ability) in Data Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, or another quantitative field 
  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field. We care more about proven ability than an exact number of years, so strong candidates with less experience are very welcome to apply 
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience with Spark is a strong advantage. 
  • Strong statistical foundations, including hypothesis testing, regression, survival analysis, experimental design, and statistical modelling. Ability to select appropriate methods, assess assumptions and limitations, and interpret results clearly. An understanding of clinical study design and biostatistics is important 
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills — you can translate ambiguous clinical, scientific, product, or business questions into well-defined analytical problems and identify appropriate approaches to answer them. 
  • Comfortable turning large, messy, real-world datasets into clear, publication-ready analyses and scientific figures 
  • Fluent in English, based in Western Europe, e.g. Switzerland, Spain, UK, France, Germany 

Nice to have 

  • Experience with advanced statistical modelling or predictive modelling  
  • Experience with Databricks and/or BI/dashboarding tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)  
  • Experience handling sensitive/clinical data and awareness of related regulations (GDPR, HIPAA)  
  • PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, or a related field 

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to success from start to end. 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly. 

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting journey

  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location)

Ready to Move the Needle? 

If you're excited about turning messy, real-world data into insights that shape both scientific publications and business decisions, and you thrive with a lot of autonomy, we'd love to hear from you.

Als Senior Consultant AWS (m/w/d) unterstützt du unsere Kunden bei der Umsetzung ihrer Cloud-Strategien und bringst dein Know-how dort ein, wo du die größte Wirkung erzielen kannst. Dabei musst du nicht alles können: Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt bewegst du dich in einem oder mehreren unserer strategischen AWS-Fokusthemen.


Was du bei uns machst

• Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung moderner AWS-Lösungen
• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Architekturen und anspruchsvolle Cloud-Projekte
• Du bringst deine Expertise in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche ein:
• Migration & Modernisation: Du begleitest Cloud-Migrationen und modernisierst bestehende Anwendungslandschaften
• Data & AI: Du entwickelst datengetriebene Lösungen und unterstützt bei Analytics-, AI- und Machine-Learning-Projekten
• Security: Du konzipierst sichere Cloud-Architekturen und unterstützt bei Security-, Compliance- und Governance-Anforderungen
• Engineering: Du automatisierst Cloud-Plattformen, setzt Infrastructure as Code um und entwickelst skalierbare AWS-Umgebungen
• Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und begleitest Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung


Wann du zu uns passt

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Umsetzung von Cloud-Lösungen auf Basis von AWS
• Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem unserer Fokusbereiche Migration & Modernisation, Data & AI, Security oder Engineering mit.
• Du verstehst es, technische Herausforderungen in nachhaltige und kundenorientierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
• Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein.
• Erfahrung mit Cloud-native Architekturen, Automatisierung, DevOps oder modernen Datenplattformen ist von Vorteil.
• Idealerweise verfügst du über relevante AWS-Zertifizierungen oder hast Interesse, diese gemeinsam mit uns zu erwerben.
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Hey, wir sind Skaylink.
Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!
 

Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. 

Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen. 

Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst. 

Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig. 

 
Was du von uns hast
 
🎯 Purpose – Deine Expertise einsetzen (in Projekten bei re­nom­mierten Unternehmen wie BMW Group, Henkel oder KWS)
🌍 Flexibilität – Deine Balance finden (u. a. Workation, Urlaubsflexibilisierung) 
📖 Entwicklung – Ankommen und Weiterkommen (u. a. Skaylink Campus, Entwicklungsgespräche, regelmäßige Befragungen der Mitarbeitenden)
🏖️ Erholung – Kraft tanken (u. a. 30 Tage Urlaub, 24. + 31.12 frei, Sabbatical) 
🚲 Mobilität – Von A nach B kommen (u. a. BusinessBike, Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket)  
💻 Ausstattung – Die Qual der Wahl (Apple/Windows, Firmenhandy) 
💪 Unterstützung – Fühl dich wohl (u. a. Employee Referral Program, Corporate Benefits, Arbeitsplatzbrille, jährlich 5 bezahlte Kind-krank-Tage) 
🏆 Events – Zusammenkommen und Feiern (u. a. Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeier, Teamevents, Cross-Company Tech-Talks) 
🧩 Miteinander – We are Skaylink! 
 
Du + Skaylink = Perfect Match? 
 
Dann bewirb dich – auch falls du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst! Wir benötigen nur deinen Lebenslauf und sind schon ganz gespannt darauf, von dir zu lesen.

title: Partner Business Director - 11748
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
 
Why join Coupa?
 
🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. 
 
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. 

The Impact of a Partner Business Director at Coupa: 

As a Partner Business Director, you are the primary architect of Coupa’s indirect revenue growth within your region. By bridging the gap between strategic alliances and regional sales teams, you transform our partner ecosystem into a high-performance engine that accelerates pipeline creation and deal execution. Your impact is measured by your ability to scale Coupa’s market presence, empower partners through world-class enablement, and ultimately deliver the transformative power of our AI-driven spend management platform to a broader global network of customers.

 


What You’ll Do
  • Lead Coupa’s strategic alliance with Accenture across EMEA – our Global Partner of the Year – driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline creation, co-sell execution, and alliance growth across the region.
  • Own and execute Coupa’s alliance strategy for Accenture across EMEA, driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and ACV growth against an agreed joint business plan
  • Manage and expand relationships across Accenture’s EMEA organisation, including its Sourcing & Procurement, Supply Chain, and Reinvention Services practices, as well as country market units and industry groups
  • Build joint account and go-to-market plans with Accenture and Coupa regional sales teams, aligned to EMEA growth priorities and key industry verticals
  • Generate new pipeline through Accenture-led prospecting, joint field events, executive roundtables, and co-marketing programs across EMEA markets
  • Lead forecasting, pipeline inspection, and deal reviews for all Accenture-related opportunities, ensuring accuracy in Salesforce and Clari
  • Support full sales cycle execution on Accenture co-sell deals, including customer engagement, RFPs, pricing, and pre-sales support
  • Run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and performance reviews with Accenture EMEA leadership against mutual pipeline, revenue, and customer success targets
  • Orchestrate executive alignment and sponsorship between Accenture and Coupa leadership, including engagement at flagship events such as Coupa Inspire and regional partner summits
  • Drive Accenture practice onboarding, enablement, and certification growth across the Coupa platform, including AI-driven Total Spend Management capabilities and new product releases
  • Act as the primary liaison between Accenture and Coupa’s EMEA sales, pre-sales, professional services, and Partner success teams, ensuring alignment, delivery quality, and deal momentum
  • Champion joint solutions, accelerators, and Accenture-built apps to differentiate the partnership and shorten sales cycles
  • Track and analyse Accenture partner performance, pipeline health, and EMEA market trends to identify white space and growth opportunities

    • What You Will Bring to Coupa
  • 7–10+ years in enterprise software sales, alliances, or channel, with significant experience managing Global Systems Integrators (GSIs)
  • Proven track record of building and scaling a GSI alliance (ideally Accenture) and driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue
  • Deep understanding of how GSIs operate, including practice structures, industry groups, country market units, and consulting-led sales motions
  • Knowledge of procurement, spend management, supply chain, or adjacent ERP/finance software markets strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of enterprise & mid-market sales cycles, co-sell execution, and pipeline management across multiple EMEA markets
  • Experience with Salesforce and forecasting tools (e.g. Clari)
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage Managing Director and Partner-level stakeholders
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, matrixed environment across cultures, countries, and time zones
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across EMEA
  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages an advantage
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
    • At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being . We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
     
    Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
    • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
    • Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
    • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
    • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
    • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
    • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
    Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.
     
    Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. 
     
    Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
     
    By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

title: Werkstudent:in Human Resources & Recruiting (m/w/d)
description:

Wir suchen Dich ab sofort an unserem Standort in München!

Data und AI gestalten unseren Alltag. Zu Deinen Herausforderungen zählen: 

  • Unterstützung unseres Recruiting-Teams im gesamten Bewerbungsprozess - von der Stellenausschreibung bis zur Einstellung
  • Erstsichtung eingehender Bewerbungen sowie Unterstützung bei der Vorauswahl geeigneter Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten

  • Unterstützung bei administrativen und operativen HR-Aufgaben entlang des gesamten Employee Life Cycles, insbesondere bei der Erstellung von Dokumenten nach Vorlage, der Pflege von Personaldaten sowie der Planung und Umsetzung des Einstellungs- und Onboardingprozesses unserer neuen Data.Musketeers
  • Mitarbeit an spannenden Projekten im People-Bereich


Dein Profil

Data ist in Deiner DNA? Das solltest Du mitbringen: 

  • Laufendes Studium im Bereich Wirtschafts-, Sozial- oder Geisteswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft, Human Resources oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Interesse an den Themen Recruiting und Human Resources sowie idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen, z. B. durch Praktika oder einer Werkstudententätigkeit
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie ein sicheres und freundliches Auftreten
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude am Umgang mit Menschen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen
  • Fließende Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift


Wir bieten

Data bewegt uns! Was Dich auf Deiner persönlichen Journey erwartet, findest Du hier:

Work-Life-Balance
Vertrauensarbeitszeit mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung - ob voll remote oder in einem unserer modern eingerichteten Innenstadtbüros (inkl. Dachterrasse), workation - nutze die Möglichkeit aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten
Kultur & Zusammenarbeit
Einzigartige Teamatmosphäre, flache Hierarchien zu unserem CEO Alex sowie eine offene Feedbackkultur, jährliche Teamworkshops auf unserem Data.Castle im Zillertal, gelebtes Data.Musketeer Prinzip – „einer für alle, alle für einen!“, unser [at] Buddy Programm zur besseren Vernetzung, regelmäßig stattfindende Fach- und Freizeitevents, hundefreundliche Büros
Fachliche & persönliche Entwicklung
Intensiver Onboarding- & Einarbeitungsprozess, persönlicher Entwicklungsplan und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, vielfältiges Workshop- und Schulungsangebot innerhalb der Data.Academy durch unsere erfahrenen Data.Musketeers sowie externen Anbieter, Führungs-, Projektleiter- und Expertenlaufbahn
Vergütung & Zusatzleistungen
Kita-Zuschuss, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20% Bezuschussung, zahlreiche Corporate Benefits & Mitarbeiterangebote (z.B. für Events und Reisen), Startguthaben in unserem internen Merchandise-Shop, kompetitives Gehalt mit variablen Anteilen
Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden
Mental Health & Wellbeing Support sowie Coaching und Meditation durch nilo.health, Fitness- und Yogaräume im Münchner Office, regelmäßige Mitarbeiterumfragen, EGYM Well Pass Mitgliedschaft mit Plus1 Option, Fahrradleasing über Jobrad nach der Probezeit, interne Gruppen für sportliche Aktivitäten, kostenlose Heiß- und Erfrischungsgetränke sowie frisches Obst im Office, Dachterrasse (Grill)
Mobilität
Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, zentrale Lage der Offices, gute Anbindung an den Öffentlichen Nahverkehr, Möglichkeit von anderen Standorten zu arbeiten

Michaela Ostertag, Principal People Partner

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About This Role

You'll join a small, high-impact Product Design team as the design partner for our Out-of-Home domain: the platform that runs and steers GLS Group's network of lockers and parcel shops across Europe. Every designer here owns a domain end-to-end, with the ownership and the access that come with that. Design already works as a strategic partner across GLS/NXT, and this role is here to grow that partnership within Out-of-Home.

You'll design for the operational teams who run the network, across markets, providers and roles. The work spans the Out-of-Home Portal (our operational management surface) and our data intelligence layer, where network performance, forecasting and optimization decisions get made. Expect complexity, ambiguity, and a short line between your decisions and the network's performance.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Lead end-to-end design for the Out-of-Home Portal and our data intelligence surfaces, from problem framing through post-launch iteration
  • Shape product direction, roadmap and prioritization together with the Out-of-Home Product Leadership
  • Turn complex operational flows and business logic into simple, beautiful experiences: information architecture, interaction design and visual craft
  • Run discovery and research with operational teams across markets, and use qualitative, quantitative, and behavioral evidence to decide what to build and to measure impact
  • Use AI to build high-quality prototypes, and validate design decisions with users and engineers before they go to build
  • Contribute to our multi-platform design system and build components that scale across our products
  • Present design work and rationale to product, engineering, operations and leadership

Requirements

Requirements

  • 4+ years designing complex software: data-heavy, workflow-driven products for professional users, ideally across multiple markets or user groups
  • A portfolio that shows how you think: ambiguous problems, the reasoning behind your decisions, and craft in the outcome. We'd like to see how AI shows up in your process
  • Strong information architecture and systems thinking: you find the patterns in a complex domain and design structures that still hold as it grows
  • Strong visual craft: composition, typography, layout, and the discipline to make dense interfaces feel calm
  • Strong research skills: user interviews, field studies, usability testing, and synthesis of insights into actionable design decisions
  • Track record of close collaboration with engineering teams, comfortable discussing technical tradeoffs and working within platform constraints
  • Pragmatic and entrepreneurial: you make sensible tradeoffs between craft and shipping, you take things on before they're assigned, and you'd rather learn from something real than perfect something hypothetical

AI and Prototyping in Code

  • AI-native in how you work: synthesis, exploration, copy, data, generating and testing options, with a clear view of where it helps and where it doesn't
  • You prototype in code: taking an idea into a prototype with realistic data, using AI-assisted coding tools or front-end frameworks
  • Interest in how these tools change the way a design team works, and willingness to shape that with us

Benefits

  • Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy
  • Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives
  • Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment
  • Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.
  • Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance
  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites
  • Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday
  • Reward system: Rewards for the recommendation of additional team members
  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow

Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well-suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully to our team.

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Eye Security

Most HRBP roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, inside the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn't it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading.

This is a 1-year fixed-term contract covering maternity leave. It's your chance to embed yourself in a growing German operation, build real infrastructure, and leave behind something that sticks all while knowing exactly what the timeline is.

 
 

About Eye Security

Eye Security protects European mid-market businesses from cyber threats: 24/7 monitoring and response, incident response, and integrated cyber insurance, all in one. We're 170+ people across the Netherlands, UK, Germany and Belgium, with roots in Dutch intelligence and national CERTs. Our mission is simple: enterprise-grade security shouldn't only be for enterprises.

We've just closed Series C and are scaling fast. Germany is a growth market for us, and we need local People leadership to match that ambition.

 
 

The Role

You'll be the People Business Partner for our German operations, partnering with sales teams, customer support & on boarding, and project management. It's the most varied population in the company.

That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You'll coach first-time managers on the basics one hour and challenge leadership on a strategic call the next. You'll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it.

And here's what makes this role bigger than the title: alongside the partnering work, you'll get to build things most HRBPs only inherit: redesigning our performance cycle for German context, rethinking benefits, shaping how development works here. You'll lead them yourself, start to finish, and see them land in the business you partner with every day.

 
 

What You'll Do

  • Be the trusted partner for German leaders in Sales and customer support: coaching, challenging, and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including leadership.

  • Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you'll be embedded in Berlin, listening to what's actually going on, not partnering from a distance.

  • Build and lead People projects end to end: think redesigning the performance cycle for German teams, refreshing benefits, or building a development approach that works for our culture, taking it from first idea to something that sticks, while your HRBP work keeps running.

  • Handle the real side of employee relations: complex cases, conduct issues, working with external counsel when needed. You've seen the tough cases and you don't flinch.

  • Apply German employment law hands-on in day-to-day decisions, and know when to bring in an expert.

 
 

What We're Looking For

  • People operations experience in a scaling tech environment. You've lived the journey from around 50 to a few hundred people and know what good looks like at 200 to 400.

  • Strong stakeholder management and the presence to challenge back, including senior leadership, without becoming the policy police.

  • A track record of hands-on project leadership: you've owned People initiatives from design to rollout yourself, not coordinated them from the sidelines.

  • Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity: our problems don't come with a manual, and you'd rather solve them creatively than wait for one.

  • Hands-on, working knowledge of German employment law.

  • Professional German (business conversations, can lead meetings with non-English speakers) and professional English.

  • Based in Berlin or the surrounding area with a hybrid attendance

 
 

What We Offer

  • Real impact: help build the People foundations of a company protecting businesses across Europe, alongside colleagues from intelligence, military, tech and consulting backgrounds.

  • Fixed-term clarity: 1-year contract (covering maternity leave), starting mid-November 2026. Know exactly what you're committing to, and build knowing you'll leave something scalable behind.

  • Flexible contract structure: we're open to employment or freelance arrangements let's find what works for you.

  • Local presence: embedded in Berlin with support from our Amsterdam People team. You're not alone, but you're trusted to lead.

  • Competitive compensation for the Berlin market, commensurate with experience.

  • MacBook Pro or Dell XPS, plus iPhone or Samsung.

  • Time off and wellbeing: generous leave, floating holidays, and a volunteering day.

  • Team connection: regular virtual and in-person collaboration with the broader Eye Security team across Netherlands, UK, Germany, and Belgium.

title: Founding Customer Support Engineer
description:
The mission:

comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures, along with top European investors.

comstruct builds AI agents for construction. Our platform automates the entire flow from the bill of quantities to the fully verified invoice: RFQs and supplier matching, bid comparison and negotiation, framework contracts and orders, digital delivery notes, invoice verification and sustainability reporting. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us bring this to an industry that still runs most of it by hand.

About the role 🦺

As our Founding Customer Support Engineer you own what happens after go-live: you keep our customers' integrations running and their teams using comstruct every day.

When a delivery note doesn't map to the right project, a 3-way match fails, or data stops flowing from a customer's SAP, you own the problem end to end. You dig into logs, APIs, and data flows to find the root cause, prepare and ship smaller pull requests yourself, and work closely with engineering on more complex fixes. When you're not deep in a technical problem, you're on calls with customers, making sure the teams that went live keep using comstruct in their daily work.

You're the person the customer calls when something breaks and the one who makes sure it doesn't break again. Inside comstruct you're the voice of the customer: you spot the feature gaps that surface in real use and prioritize with the Product Engineering team which ones get built.

The deeper you get into how the product works and where it falls short, the more the door opens to move into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and ship those fixes and features yourself.

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Own inquiries end-to-end: Our customers run some of the largest construction sites in Europe. When something breaks, it's real: trucks, deliveries, invoices, deadlines.

  • Automate support with our own agents: We sell AI agents; support is a function where we also deploy them internally. You'll work out which parts of the flow an agent can handle and where the human touch still wins.

  • Ship the fix when it's yours to ship: Small PRs, config and mapping changes, data repair scripts, clearer error handling. Reviewed by engineering, shipped by you.

  • Kill recurring issues: Every ticket is a data point. You spot the patterns, bring them to Product Engineering with evidence, and push for the change that makes that ticket class disappear.

  • Build the support foundation: Playbook, macros, help center, internal runbooks. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll write the first version of it as you learn, with the founders and engineering behind you.

  • Report what matters: Time to first response, time to resolution on integration breaks, and how many recurring issue classes you eliminated. You consistently share where we stand with Customer Value Engineers and the wider team.

What we’re looking for ✨

  • 1 - 2 years in a technical, customer-facing role: Customer Success or Support Engineer, Solution Engineer, Implementation, TAM or similar.

  • You're comfortable in APIs, logs, SQL and data flows and can debug across systems you didn't build. You know when an issue is the integration, the data or the product.

  • You can explain a failed integration to an engineer and to a non-technical customer stakeholder, and both walk away clear.

  • You want to understand how the product works under the hood instead of treating it as a black box.

  • You are willing to work five days a week from our Munich office with occasional customer travel.

  • You are native in German and fluent in English.

Nice to have: Ideally, you have initial experience with Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch.

What we offer

  • A path into building: This role is a launchpad. As you learn how customers use the product and where it breaks, you can grow into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and build the fixes and features yourself.

  • Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan.

  • Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CTO Dominik Brosch, plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC.

  • Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware.

  • Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company.

  • Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca, Italy and Portugal.

description:
Please note that this is a hybrid position based in Cardiff, requiring 3 days onsite each week, with the option for remote work on the remaining days.

Atomic Theory is a multinational team of seasoned AAA veterans with roots at studios like Blizzard, PUBG, Epic Games, and Unity. We’re passionate about building player-first experiences with strong engineering foundations, performance excellence, and accessibility baked in from day one.

With offices in Albany, NY; Austin, TX; Cardiff, UK; and Brighton, UK, we operate globally with one mindset: Get Sh!t Done.

ABOUT THE ROLE:


As an Mid-Level UI/UX Designer, you are a fully capable, independent contributor who handles complex UI tasks and systems within your domain.


You take ownership of mid-scope UI features and solve complex design or technical challenges. You are expected to work autonomously, unblock peers when necessary, and ensure your work is high-quality, stable, and integrated into the project pipeline.


At this level, you are not leading the team, but you are a key contributor whose technical and design expertise keeps features moving forward efficiently.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Design, implement, and optimise complex UI features and systems (menus, HUD modules, dynamic flows, procedural elements).

  • Develop and maintain UI libraries, reusable components, and critical systems to support your feature domain.

  • Implement and optimise or have knowledge of custom UI shaders, materials, or advanced animations to achieve specific visual or functional goals.

  • Debug and solve technical UI issues (engine, blueprint, middleware) to unblock your feature work.

  • Validate UI functionality and appearance across resolutions, aspect ratios, and gameplay contexts.

  • Improve personal and small-team workflows to increase efficiency and reliability.

  • Contribute to UX flows, usability, and interface consistency within your domain.

  • Maintain documentation for tools, systems, and components to ensure clarity and reproducibility.

  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and producers to integrate features smoothly.

WHAT WE VALUE:

  • 3+ years of experience in UI/UX design (games or interactive products).

  • Proven ability to deliver mid-scope UI features independently, including complex interactions or procedural systems.

  • Proficiency with design tools (Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator) and engine implementation (Unreal, Unity).

  • Strong understanding of UI technical fundamentals, including layout, anchoring, slicing, optimisation, and Blueprint/scripting basics.

  • Ability to debug and resolve complex technical and design challenges within your feature domain.

  • Experience developing or optimising UI systems or libraries that improve efficiency and consistency.

  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to flag blockers and propose practical solutions.

  • Strong grasp of UI/UX fundamentals, usability, readability, and accessibility.

  • Passion for polished, performant, and intuitive player experiences.


WHAT YOU MAY ALSO HAVE:

  • Experience with dynamic HUDs, procedural UI, or live-service UI elements.

  • Familiarity with UI middleware or advanced engine pipelines.

  • Experience building shader-based UI, advanced materials, or complex animations.

  • Exposure to UX metrics, usability testing, or iterative optimisation.


WHAT WE CAN OFFER:

Competitive Salary and Benefits Package: Your health and wellbeing is important to us, so we offer a variety of benefits including:

  • Hybrid Working Arrangement: Our office in Brighton is located centrally. As a member of our team, you’ll have the flexibility to work at home and collaborate with your fellow team members in person.

  • Private Pension via Salary Sacrifice

  • Optional Private Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

  • Annual Leave, plus Bank Holidays and Winter Break Office Closure

  • Annual Research Credit: We always encourage personal growth, so we provide all of our team members with an annual credit to further enhance your skills!

  • Professional Development: We offer annual reviews, as well as opportunities to collaborate across disciplines, internal tech talks, and the chance to learn from specialists with backgrounds from across the games and software development industries.

  • Work-Life Balance: We really believe that home life comes first and we promote a flexible working environment. And as an added bonus: We don’t crunch!

  • Family Friendly: We understand the importance of family, which is why we offer 6 weeks full of Maternity, Paternity, and Adoption Leave to support you during this exciting time!

  • Office Perks: In addition to everything above, we also provide:

    • Weekly Team Lunches

    • Snacks, Including the Good (Yorkshire) Tea

    • Fully Equipped Team Lounge, Including our Favourite Consoles and Games

    • And, most importantly, a supportive and creative working environment made up of talented and friendly people, as well as the opportunity to work on some pretty cool games and projects – if we do say so ourselves!

Let us do the work for you: Even if your profile isn’t an exact match for all of the qualifications listed above, we still want you to apply. Our team members come from a variety of different industries, not all of which are immediately relevant to game or software development, and we welcome all candidates of similarly varied backgrounds, communities, and identities.

description:
What is the job?

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.

  • Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.

  • Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.

  • Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.

  • Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.

  • Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.

  • Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.

What do you need?

  • Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.

  • Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.

  • A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.

  • Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.

  • Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: PPC Marketing Lead
description:
What is the job?

As our Lead Paid Search guru, you'll own paid search performance end to end - not from a distance, but in-platform, every day. This is a fully hands-on role for someone who lives in Google Ads, is driven by results, and finds real satisfaction in building, testing and optimising campaigns themselves.

You'll take full ownership of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts - from strategy and campaign structure through to bid management, ad copy, tracking and reporting, across a six to seven-figure monthly budget. One day you'll be knee-deep in search term reports and bid adjustments; the next you'll be presenting forecasts and performance insight to stakeholders who need clarity, not jargon.

Paid search doesn't sit in isolation, so you'll be the connective tissue between Creative, Analytics, Product and wider Marketing- making sure tracking, messaging and landing pages all work together to hit the numbers. You'll also work closely with our Google account management team and counterparts across our Australian business, sharing insight and aligning strategy across markets. You'll constantly be testing what's next: new formats, new automation, new platform features, always looking for the edge that keeps performance ahead of the curve.

We're looking for someone who combines deep platform expertise with real data fluency - someone equally comfortable building a budget forecast as they are troubleshooting a broken conversion tag. As we grow internationally, experience across multilingual or international accounts is a genuine advantage, though what matters most is your ability to turn performance data into decisions, and decisions into results.

What will you be doing?

  • Own end-to-end paid search strategy and execution across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, from account structure and keyword research to bid management, DemGen strategy and ad copy
